subject.title: fix(agents): run embedded gateway fallback on a fresh session after abnormal close

question: Should every `closed` gateway transport failure abandon the explicit session key, including a close before gateway acceptance, or should fresh-session fallback be limited to the accepted-turn recovery race?
rationale: The correct boundary depends on intended session-continuity semantics across an uncertain remote acceptance state; the supplied patch and test demonstrate the accepted-turn case but do not establish the other timing window.

options.title: Confirm fresh fallback for all closes
options.body: Keep the unified closed/timeout behavior and add live evidence covering both acceptance timing windows.

options.title: Limit fresh fallback to accepted turns
options.body: Preserve explicit-session continuity when no gateway acceptance was observed, while isolating the known accepted-turn restart race.

recommendation.title: Confirm fresh fallback for all closes
recommendation.body: Keep the unified closed/timeout behavior and add live evidence covering both acceptance timing windows.
